title: 第一卷 第23章 合欢宗最后的净土第一卷 第24章 这才是双修真正魔宗
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉

三天后。
合欢宗主峰，更高处。
李寒山站在洞府门口，打量着花弄影的这处新住处。
与之前那处幽静小院不同，这里的灵气浓郁了数倍不止。洞府开凿在山壁之上，门前是一片平整的石台，种着几株灵竹，山风吹过，竹叶沙沙作响。放眼望去，云海翻涌，远处四座山峰如巨柱般耸立，气势磅礴。
“寒郎，这地方还不错吧？”
花弄影走来，她筑基之后，整个人的气质都有了微妙的变化，原本就勾人的眼眸中多了几分从容，举手投足间的风情也愈发自然。
在没人的时候，她对李寒山也以寒郎相称，这是李寒山的要求。
现在注意到他们的人太多了，万一有金丹以上的长老以神识悄无声息的探查，花弄影一个称呼，就有可能暴露两人的真实关系。
李寒山点头：“确实不错。”
花弄影指向远处的山峰：“寒郎你看，合欢宗一共五座山峰。咱们所在的是主峰，实力越强，住的位置就越高。像我刚突破筑基的核心弟子，只能住在这个高度。”
她手指移动，指向东边一座苍翠的山峰：“那是碧玉峰，专门种植灵药的地方，由江长老掌管。”
江念微？
这么说，许灵溪那妮子也住在这座山峰上。
“那是赤火峰，炼丹炼器都在那里，南边是文藏峰，宗门宝库与藏经阁在那里......”
花弄影继续介绍了起来。
李寒山听完后，问道：“对了，许灵溪那丫头现在是什么情况，需要参加宗门考核吗？”
花弄影道：“她算是江长老的亲传弟子，不纳入全宗考核。”
李寒山眉头一挑：“亲传弟子就不用考核？”
“当然。”花弄影点头，“亲传弟子是长老亲自教导，地位超然，不受宗门常规考核的约束。但每个长老能收的亲传弟子数量有限，像江长老那样的金丹修士，最多也就能收三五个。”

她顿了顿，语气变得严肃起来：“不过寒郎，你要小心，长老们收亲传弟子，很多时候都别有用心。”
李寒山看向她。
花弄影难得没有嬉皮笑脸：“有些长老把亲传弟子当炉鼎养，养肥了再一口吃掉；有些则是看中了某种特殊体质，想要夺舍；还有些更过分，把亲传弟子炼成傀儡，供自己驱使。”
“那江念微......”
“江长老人还不错。”花弄影道，“她一心炼丹，在宗内地位超卓，修为提升靠的是丹药，对男女之事兴趣不大，收徒也是看资质和心性。许灵溪跟着她，算是福气。”
李寒山点点头，心里为许灵溪松了口气。
花弄影忽然想起什么，从储物袋中取出血玉灵芝，道：“主人，这株血玉灵芝若是直接使用，药力只能吸收五成左右。若能请动江长老出手，炼成血玉锻体丹，药效至少能翻三倍。”
李寒山心中一动。
三倍药效？这差距可不小。
花弄影继续道：“江长老是合欢宗最擅长炼丹的长老之一，一手炼丹术出神入化。若是旁人去求，她多半理都不会理。但主人你不同，你不是有许灵溪那丫头吗？”
李寒山明白了她的意思：“你是说，通过灵溪去请江长老帮忙？”
“正是。”花弄影道，“那丫头对主人死心塌地的，只要主人开口，她肯定会帮忙。江长老看在她的面子上，多半不会拒绝。”
李寒山沉吟片刻，点头道：“好，我去试试。”
“那奴家等主人的好消息。”
花弄影将血玉灵芝递给他。
李寒山将灵芝收入储物袋，祭出飞剑，朝碧玉峰飞去。

Three days later.
The main peak of Hehuan Sect is higher.
Li Hanshan stood at the entrance of the cave and looked at Hua Nongying's new residence.
Different from the quiet courtyard before, the aura here is several times richer. The cave is dug into the mountain wall. In front of the door is a flat stone platform with several spiritual bamboos planted. The mountain wind blows and the bamboo leaves rustle. Looking around, the sea of ​​clouds is rolling, and four peaks in the distance stand like giant pillars, majestic.
"Hanlang, is this place not bad?"
Hua Nongying came over. After she established her foundation, her whole temperament changed subtly. Her originally charming eyes became a little more calm, and her gestures became more natural.
When no one is around, she treats Li Hanshan as Han Lang, which is Li Hanshan's request.
There are too many people paying attention to them now. If an elder with a golden elixir or above quietly investigates with their spiritual consciousness, just calling Hua Nongying may expose the true relationship between the two.
Li Hanshan nodded: "It's indeed good."
Hua Nongying pointed to the mountain peak in the distance: "Look, Hanlang, there are five peaks in the Hehuan Sect. We are on the main peak. The stronger we are, the higher we live. Core disciples like me who have just broken through the foundation building can only live at this height."
She moved her fingers and pointed to a green mountain peak in the east: "That's Jasper Peak, a place dedicated to growing elixirs. It's under the control of Elder Jiang."
Jiang Nianwei?
So, Xu Lingxi’s nanny also lives on this mountain peak.
"That's the Scarlet Fire Peak, where alchemy and weapon refining are all done. To the south is Wenzang Peak, where the sect's treasure house and scripture library are..."
Hua Nongying continued to introduce.
After listening, Li Hanshan asked: "By the way, what's going on with that girl Xu Lingxi now? Does she need to take part in the sect's assessment?"
Hua Nongying said: "She is considered Elder Jiang's direct disciple and is not included in the entire sect's assessment."
Li Hanshan raised his eyebrows: "A direct disciple doesn't need to take the assessment?"
"Of course." Hua Nongying nodded, "The direct disciples are personally taught by the elders. They have a transcendent status and are not subject to the regular assessment of the sect. However, each elder can only accept a limited number of direct disciples. A golden elixir monk like Elder Jiang can only accept three or five at most."
She paused and her tone became serious: "But Han Lang, you have to be careful. Elders often have ulterior motives when recruiting direct disciples."
Li Hanshan looked at her.
It was rare for Hua Nongying not to have a playful smile on her face: "Some elders raise their direct disciples like furnaces, fatten them up and then eat them in one bite; some are interested in a certain special physique and want to seize them; and some go even further, turning their direct disciples into puppets for themselves to control."
"Then Jiang Nianwei..."
"Elder Jiang is not bad." Hua Nongying said, "She is devoted to alchemy and has an outstanding status in the sect. She relies on elixirs to improve her cultivation. She is not very interested in men and women. She accepts disciples based on their aptitude and temperament. Xu Lingxi follows her, which is considered a blessing."
Li Hanshan nodded, feeling relieved for Xu Lingxi.
Hua Nongying suddenly remembered something and took out the Blood Jade Ganoderma lucidum from the storage bag and said: "Master, if this Blood Jade Ganoderma lucidum is used directly, it can only absorb about 50% of the medicinal power. If Elder Jiang can be asked to make a blood jade body-building pill, the medicinal effect can be at least tripled."
Li Hanshan's heart moved.
Triple the potency? This gap is not small.
Hua Nongying continued: "Elder Jiang is one of the elders in the Hehuan Sect who is best at alchemy. He is extremely skilled in alchemy. If others ask for help, she will probably ignore it. But Master, you are different. Don't you have that girl Xu Lingxi?"
Li Hanshan understood what she meant: "You mean, go through Lingxi to ask Elder Jiang for help?"
"Exactly." Hua Nongying said, "That girl is devoted to her master. As long as he asks, she will definitely help. Elder Jiang will probably not refuse for her sake."
Li Hanshan pondered for a moment, nodded and said: "Okay, I'll give it a try."
"The slave family is waiting for good news from the master. "
Hua Nongying handed him the Blood Jade Ganoderma lucidum.
Li Hanshan put the Ganoderma lucidum into his storage bag, took out his flying sword, and flew towards the Jade Peak.
